R06. Complete live AI provider fixtures and four-role authenticated browser QA on the exact target deployment. Test timeout, malformed output, fallback, revocation, CSRF, IDOR, replay, owner-only panels, back/forward/refresh and private URL expiry. Mock transport is not live-provider proof.
R07. Prove real backup/PITR and restore. Record secret-free environment fingerprint, safety point, retention, actual isolated restore, row/FK/hash checks, app boot, measured RTO and observed RPO. Select contractual objectives only when the owner has chosen them. Do not restore over Production.
R08. Produce final evidence and GO/NO-GO only after exact-source gates and operational checks. Prepare reviewable integration/cutover/rollback packets before requesting any still-required consequential owner decision. No missing mandatory evidence can become 100%.

D09. Rerun required two final gates after last source change and record their state identity, exact results/skips, commands and artifacts. The remote ledger's 16,978 PASS labels are classification output, not 16,978 independently passing tests.
D10. Provide the final simple owner handoff, full manual/runtime matrix and actionable remaining boundaries. Identify which tasks are code complete, locally verified, remotely published, deployed, operationally accepted or owner/external blocked.
